messages:
maria: Heads up - CI microbench failed on PR #17690. Threshold diffs show a kv-cache hit drop and batcher throughput regression. link: https://ci.internal.redwood/bench/5367890 :eyes:
perf-bot: [ALERT] microbench threshold exceeded: batch_throughput -10.9% | kv_hit_rate -17.7% | job=pr-17690/parallel-8
alex: Can you repro locally or is this CI noise?
maria: Reproducible on my devbox with the microbench harness. Command I used: `tools/bench/run_microbench --pr 17690 --seq 2048 --warmup 500`
maria: Failing summary:
```
Batcher throughput: baseline=1234 tok/s new=1098 tok/s (-10.9%)
KV hit rate: baseline=0.62 new=0.51 (-17.7%)
```
ken: That magnitude of kv hit drop looks like an eviction/path change, not just variance. Did the PR touch kernel-autoselect or batching heuristics?
maria: PR changed kernel-autoselect preference: prefer 'fast-2' for seq>1024 (commit 9f3b7d). Also a small tweak to batcher prefactor.
alex: Could kernel switch cause different cache line layouts and evictions -> lower kv hit? Seems plausible. Can we bisect?
perf-bot: Received: `/bisect pr 17690`. Starting bisect run across commits 9f3b7d..9f3b7d (single-commit suspect)
perf-bot: Bisect result: culprit commit = 9f3b7d (kernel pref change). Confidence 96%.
maria: Local bisect confirms. If I force kernel=legacy the microbench returns to baseline numbers.
ken: Ok this is a rollout blocker. Options: revert the kernel-autoselect change, or pin kernel for the CI/dedicated fleet until we can investigate. Which is faster?
maria: I opened a revert PR (17691) that flips the autoselect preference back. Link: https://git.internal.redwood/revert/17691
sre-oncall: Marking this as rollout-blocker per policy. Please include postmortem label and owner.
alex: Short-term: merge revert to un-block and then open a follow-up to fix kernel selector heuristics with more robust warmup and seq-distribution tests.
ken: Also add a perf unit test that checks kv_hit_rate delta for representative seq histograms. We keep failing on these subtle kernel-layout regressions without that guard.
maria: Filed INF-472 with repro, flamegraphs and trace (includes `perf top` and kv-cache counters).
maria: Action items: revert merged (PR 17691), hotfix config to pin kernel=legacy on Dedicated pools for the next deployment window, add perf unit test, and follow-up root-cause investigation ticket.
ken: I'll push the config hotfix to the staging fleet now. ETA ~15m.
sre-oncall: Please monitor canary after revert. I'll keep an eye on alerts.
maria: Thanks all. After revert I'll post the perf flamegraphs and a short writeup about why autoselect picked fast-2 (seq distribution + warmup interaction). :thumbsup:
alex: Nice quick triage. Follow-up: add deterministic benchmark seed to reduce noise across CI runs.
maria: Agreed, added to INF-472. Closing blocker for now once revert is green.
